caveats: the band improvement is a VOL model, not an alpha model: per-stock rvol_20 drives it; the score's own E[ret|up] differentiation is weak (bin-pooled slope 0.36/-0.23)
pooled coverage hits 0.80 only via the conformal lambda (~1.07-1.09): walk-forward train pools systematically under-estimate future tail width; per-stock pooling cannot fix this temporal piece

per-date coverage still swings with the market (drop-2025 cut leaves remaining-date coverage 0.73); 0.80 is a POOLED guarantee, not per-date; vol-aware bands slightly increase per-date coverage dispersion (cov_err t -2.5..-2.8)
42 test dates with overlapping fwd windows at h20 -> per-date t-stats optimistic; rely on positive-date fraction (95-100%) and subset cuts
bin/cell train pools follow caliblib d<t convention (last 1-2 train labels partially overlap test window) for baseline comparability; the conformal pool is stricter (fully matured labels only)
